other_conditions: Only one member per family is eligible for benefits
Applicant must own or have access to land near a water source
Applicant must have a valid Aadhaar card and Aadhaar‑linked mobile number
Applicant must link their ration card with Aadhaar for e‑KYC verification
Applicant must pay a 10% contribution fee as per the unit cost
Registered office of the group/organization must be located in Jharkhand
benefits_summary: Farmers receive a 90% subsidy on solar‑powered irrigation units, lowering agricultural costs and promoting sustainable irrigation.
